Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest

Class LoaderInteractionGameTestsLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest.LoaderInteractionGameTestsLogic
public final class LoaderInteractionGameTestsLogic extends Object
Each loader's own use and player-copy hooks, driven through the loader's event or callback rather than the shared service behind it. Fabric protection-listener ordering remains a manual check.

  • Method Details

    • playerCopiesKeepEyesOnlyWhileAlive

      public static void playerCopiesKeepEyesOnlyWhileAlive(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer template, LoaderInteractionGameTestsLogic.Copy copy)
      Players keep their applied eyes when the game copies them alive (leaving the End) and lose them on death. In game: apply a Slimy Eye tinted to glow to yourself, leave the End through its exit portal, and keep the same eyes; die and respawn, and the applied eyes are gone.

    • useHooksHonorResults

      public static void useHooksHonorResults(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer template, LoaderInteractionGameTestsLogic.Use use, boolean testRefusal)
      The loader's use hooks apply and harvest eyes on a cow, a boat, an armor stand, a placed head, and the player, and with testRefusal, a protection listener's refusal leaves everything as it was. In game: apply and harvest eyes on each with a Slimy Eye and Optometrist shears (sneak and use the shears in the air for yourself); then repeat inside a claim that refuses the click, and the eyes, items, shears durability, your health, and drops stay unchanged. Fabric runs only the registered callbacks here; check its claim ordering by hand.
